amount.description: Amount to send (in major units, e.g., 1000 for ₦1,000)

externalReference.description: Your unique reference for this payout

destination_amount.description: Amount received by beneficiary (in smallest unit)

source_amount.description: Amount debited from the source wallet

destination_amount.description: Amount credited to the destination wallet

rateToken.description: Token to lock in this rate for a swap

toCurrency.description: Destination currency code (must differ from fromCurrency)

fromAmount.description: Amount to swap from source currency

rateToken.description: Rate token from /wallet/rates to lock in a specific rate

amount.description: Amount in the smallest unit (e.g. kobo for NGN, cents for USD)

externalReference.description: Your own unique reference for this transaction

beneficiaryId.description: ID of a saved beneficiary. Use this OR inlineBeneficiary.

inlineBeneficiary.description: One-time beneficiary details (use instead of beneficiaryId)

saveBeneficiary.description: Save the inline beneficiary for future use

deductFeesFromBalance.description: If true, fees are taken from your wallet balance so the beneficiary receives the exact amount

InlineBeneficiary.description: One-time beneficiary details (use instead of beneficiaryId). Required fields depend on currency and withdrawal_method — see the endpoint docs for per-currency examples.

withdrawal_method.description: Required for USD, GBP, EUR, and crypto. NGN defaults to local transfer.

account_name.description: Account holder name. Required for all currencies except EUR SEPA. For crypto, used as a display nickname.

account_number.description: Required for NGN, USD, GBP local (8 digits), GBP international, EUR international. Not required for EUR SEPA or crypto.

bank_name.description: Required for NGN, USD, GBP. Not required for EUR SEPA or crypto.

bank_code.description: Required for NGN (e.g. '000014' for Access Bank).

swift_code.description: Required for USD international_wire, GBP international_wire, EUR international_wire, and other currencies.

sort_code.description: Required for GBP local_transfer. Must be exactly 6 digits.

bank_address.description: Required for USD, GBP (international), EUR (international), and XAF/other currencies.

beneficiary_address.description: Required for USD and GBP. Street, city, state, postalCode, and country.

wallet_address.description: Required for crypto_usdt and crypto_usdc. Must be 26–64 alphanumeric characters. Use with currency: USD.

wallet_chain.description: Required for crypto_usdt and crypto_usdc. The blockchain network (e.g. 'ethereum', 'tron'). Use with currency: USD.

intermediary_bank_name.description: Optional. Intermediary bank for USD international_wire.

intermediary_bank_routing_number.description: Optional. Intermediary bank routing number for USD international_wire.

contact_person.description: Optional. Contact person at the beneficiary.

loanAccountId.description: ID of the loan account to draw from

destinationWalletId.description: ID of the wallet to receive funds

loanAccountId.description: ID of the loan account to repay

sourceWalletId.description: ID of the wallet to pay from

recipient_business_id.description: Required for rolla_transfer. The UUID of the destination Rolla business.

bank_address.description: Bank's physical address. Required for USD domestic and international wire transfers.

beneficiary_address.description: Beneficiary's physical address. Required for USD domestic and international wire transfers.

recipient_business_id.description: Required for rolla_transfer. The UUID of the destination Rolla business.

permissions.description: List of permissions granted by this role

email.description: Email address of the person to invite

fullname.description: Full name of the person to invite

role_id.description: UUID of the role to assign. Retrieve available roles from `GET /teams/roles`.

status.description: New status for the team member
